title: Pure Dark Lucius
match: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
summary: Pure Dark Lucius EARTH Fiend LV evolution strategy centered on negating battle destruction triggers and evolving from LV4 into the banishing juggernaut Dark Lucius LV8. By utilizing Moon Mirror Shield and Burden of the Mighty to ensure combat victory, supported by Tour Guide and Fiendish Rhino Warrior, the deck steadily climbs through its levels to lock down opposing GY effects.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tour Guide From the Underworld on Normal Summon Special Summons Fiendish Rhino Warrior directly from the Deck.
Fiendish Rhino Warrior shields all Fiend monsters you control (including Dark Lucius LV4 and LV6) from battle and card effect destruction while waiting for the Standby Phase to evolve.
Level Up! sends a face-up Dark Lucius LV4 or LV6 from the field to the GY to immediately Special Summon the next higher Level form from hand or Deck, bypassing battle evolution.
Moon Mirror Shield equips to Dark Lucius LV4 or LV6, guaranteeing it always beats the opponent's monster by 100 ATK to trigger its evolution condition.

summary.title: Opening: Tour Guide + Dark Lucius LV4
steps: Normal Summon Tour Guide From the Underworld and activate its effect to Special Summon Fiendish Rhino Warrior from your Deck.
Link Summon Muckraker From the Underworld using Tour Guide and Fiendish Rhino Warrior.
Trigger Fiendish Rhino Warrior in the GY to send Dark Lucius LV4 from your Deck to the GY.
Activate Muckraker From the Underworld, discarding a card to Special Summon Dark Lucius LV4 from your GY.
Equip Moon Mirror Shield to Dark Lucius LV4 and attack an opponent's monster, destroying it and negating its effects to trigger LV4's Standby Phase evolution into LV6.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Dark Lucius LV8 possesses 2800 ATK; when summoned by Dark Lucius LV6 (or Level Modulation), it negates the effects of all monsters it destroys by battle AND banishes them instead of sending them to the GY.
Dark Lucius LV6 negates the GY effects of monsters it destroys by battle (if summoned by LV4) and sends itself to the GY during your next Standby Phase to summon LV8.
Dark Lucius LV4 negates the effects of monsters it destroys by battle, evolving into LV6 during your next Standby Phase.
Muckraker From the Underworld provides on-demand Fiend revival from the GY and protects your monsters from destruction by tributing a Fiend.
I:P Masquerena enables Quick Link plays during the opponent's Main Phase, conferring effect destruction immunity.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Moon Mirror Shield sets the equipped monster's ATK/DEF to 100 above the battling monster during damage calculation, guaranteeing that even 1000 ATK LV4 overcomes any boss.
Burden of the Mighty reduces opposing face-up monsters' ATK by 100 times their Level, severely weakening threats for Dark Lucius.
Level Modulation Special Summons Dark Lucius LV8 from the GY ignoring its summoning conditions, letting the opponent draw 2 cards in exchange for an instant 2800 ATK boss.
The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension shuffles 2 LV monsters from your GY back into the Deck, keeping Level Up! and field evolutions live.
